description: Foley identity artwork created with Unfold, not footage or sound generated by Foley.
runtime_note: These versions describe the artwork generator. Foley's sound-design runtime uses Amplifier Agent 0.22.

foley-logo-motion.mp4.derivation: Cropped and re-encoded from the actual Unfold MP4, then renamed without changing bytes.

foley-logo.png.derivation: Transparent frame-zero lockup from the actual Unfold alpha render.

foley-mark-64.png.derivation: Downsampled symbol from the same frame, not redrawn.

limits: Raster artwork, not vector output. No trademark clearance or Microsoft endorsement is claimed.
